title: Barry went off a cliff for food
description: Barry Adams went abseiling off the Avon Gorge to raise money and awareness for FareShare South West
author: Inge Dowden
html:
A Daring Descent for a Worthy Cause

Have you ever looked at the Avon Gorge and thought, "I wonder what it would be like to dangle from that cliff?" Well, Barry Adams, our brave MD, took that curiosity to heart—but with a noble purpose.

A Leap of Faith for Food

On a sunny Saturday in October, Barry embarked on an exhilarating abseil down the Avon Gorge. His daring feat was not just a personal thrill-seeking adventure; it was a heartfelt commitment to a cause that's close to his heart: FareShare South West.

The Power of Surplus Food

FareShare South West is a remarkable organisation dedicated to combating food poverty in the South West region. Founded in 2007, their mission is simple yet profound: to redistribute surplus food, preventing it from going to waste and providing vital nourishment to those in need.

By rescuing quality, in-date food that would otherwise be discarded, FareShare turns an environmental problem into a social solution. This innovative approach not only reduces food waste but also ensures that communities have access to nutritious meals.

Why Barry Took the Plunge

Barry's decision to abseil down the Avon Gorge was driven by his deep admiration for FareShare's work. He understands the impact that food insecurity can have on individuals and families, and he wanted to contribute to a cause that is making a tangible difference.

"I've always been passionate about giving back to my community," Barry explained. "When I learned about FareShare's mission, I knew I wanted to get involved in a meaningful way. We have been supporting them for years with various initiatives, and abseiling down the Avon Gorge seemed like a challenging yet rewarding way to raise more awareness and funds for this incredible organisation."

Join Barry's Mission

Barry's courageous act is a testament to the power of individual action. By taking on this daring challenge, he's hoping to inspire others to join him in supporting FareShare South West.

If you're moved by Barry's story and want to make a difference, please consider donating to his JustGiving page. Every contribution, no matter how small, will help FareShare continue its vital work of providing food to those who need it most.

Let's show our support for Barry and FareShare by coming together to create a more just and equitable society.
